jobs.title: Design codex
jobs.objective: Design RFC 0043 V1 across two tracks. Track A (schema + migration): the 15 repo-local tables (runs, sessions, jobs, queue_messages, leases, work_packets, artifacts, verdicts, blockers, command_requests, process_executions, events, job_worktrees, process_supervisors, process_supervisor_pointers) moved into daemon-owned Postgres under repository_id namespace; new daemon-side SQL migration under src/striatum/daemon_pg/sql/; new CLI verb `striatum daemon migrate-repo-local --from sqlite --to pg --repo <path> [--dry-run] [--keep-sqlite-readonly] [--confirm-delete]`; SERIALIZABLE single-tx migrate; audit-chain byte-equivalence re-anchor. Track B (CLI behavior + RPC registry): retire --no-daemon flag (unknown-option error); exit code 11 (daemon_unreachable) + 12 (repo_not_migrated) with platform-specific remediation; daemon-required refusal in src/striatum/cli/dispatch.py; expand RFC 0030 method registry under src/striatum/daemon_rpc/ to cover every mutation enumerated in src/striatum/cli/mutations.py per RFC 0043 §5. Cite src/striatum/schema.py, src/striatum/migrations.py, src/striatum/db.py, src/striatum/cli/parser.py, src/striatum/cli/dispatch.py, src/striatum/cli/mutations.py, src/striatum/daemon_rpc/, src/striatum/daemon_pg/sql/, src/striatum/daemon_pg/migrations.py. D094 supersedes D006/D007/D036 and the SQLite half of D009.

jobs.title: Synth codex
jobs.objective: Reconcile the three designs into one concrete plan with two implementer tracks: Track A (schema + migrate-repo-local, codex) and Track B (CLI surface + RPC registry, claude). Pick one substrate strategy — do not enumerate alternatives.

jobs.title: Review design claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Review synthesis. Are all 15 tables enumerated with their new repository_id column and indexes? Is migrate-repo-local UX safe + reversible (dry-run, keep-sqlite-readonly default, confirm-delete required for destructive)? Method-registry expansion list complete vs src/striatum/cli/mutations.py? Daemon-unreachable / not-migrated error messages actionable on Linux/macOS?

jobs.title: Implement Track A schema + migrate-repo-local (codex Python)
jobs.objective: Track A — Daemon-side schema for 15 repo-local tables under repository_id namespace + the `striatum daemon migrate-repo-local --from sqlite --to pg --repo <path> [--dry-run] [--keep-sqlite-readonly] [--confirm-delete]` CLI verb. New SQL migration file under src/striatum/daemon_pg/sql/ creates tables with NOT NULL repository_id + (repository_id, ...) indexes; reuse RFC 0033 roles (daemon read-write, append-only on events/artifacts via revoked UPDATE/DELETE, migration role). Single SERIALIZABLE transaction migrate that preserves created_at/event_id ordering and re-anchors audit chain byte-equivalently. --keep-sqlite-readonly default renames state.sqlite3 to state.sqlite3.tombstone mode 0444; --confirm-delete required for destructive cleanup. Idempotent re-run via repo_migrations checkpoint row. Sub-agents per cluster: schema SQL, migrate command body, audit-chain re-anchor, tombstone handling, fixture v1_repo_local_sqlite. Do NOT modify src/striatum/cli/ surface or src/striatum/daemon_rpc/ registry — sister Track B owns those. Backward-compat: existing test fixtures continue to pass against daemon_mode=on.

jobs.title: Implement Track B CLI surface + RPC registry (claude Python)
jobs.objective: Track B — CLI surface + RPC method registry. (1) Retire --no-daemon: remove the flag from src/striatum/cli/parser.py so parsing returns the standard unknown-option error per RFC 0043 §3. (2) Wire exit code 11 (daemon_unreachable) in src/striatum/cli/dispatch.py — stderr names daemon socket path + platform remediation (systemctl --user / launchctl / striatumd --foreground / Postgres install hints). (3) Wire exit code 12 (repo_not_migrated) — CLI verbs against an unmigrated repo refuse with `migrate-repo-local` remediation. (4) Expand RFC 0030 method registry under src/striatum/daemon_rpc/ to cover every mutation enumerated in src/striatum/cli/mutations.py per RFC 0043 §5 table (session.register, work.claim_next/ack/heartbeat/complete/block/release, artifact.publish, review.submit/verdict, decision.record, checkpoint.resolve, recovery.requeue_stale/cancel_job/resume, worktree.create, branch.confirm, run.prepare/start/pause/resume/cancel, supervise.* (already present), workflow.validate/generate, plus read-capability methods for status/why/dashboard/doctor/run summary/run graph/evidence export). Sub-agents per concern: parser retirement, exit-code wiring + remediation text, RPC method-registry expansion clusters (claim / write / review / admin / recovery / read), daemon doctor remediation. Do NOT touch src/striatum/daemon_pg/sql/ or migrate-repo-local body — sister Track A owns those. Backward-compat: existing test fixtures continue to pass against daemon_mode=on; integration tests use the daemon-mediated path only.

jobs.title: Build review codex threat_model
jobs.objective: Threat-model review across both tracks: schema invariants (append-only events/artifacts grants retained, repository_id NOT NULL, indexes correct), audit-chain byte-equivalent verification in migrate-repo-local, method-registry exhaustive (no mutation bypasses the registry), --no-daemon truly removed (no silent SQLite fallback path remains).

jobs.title: Build review claude ergonomics_dx
jobs.objective: Operator UX review: migrate-repo-local dry-run output legible; tombstone semantics obvious; daemon-unreachable message names the socket + names the remediation; daemon doctor still works without daemon; SQLite stays readable post-migration so operator can re-open it for inspection; exit codes 11/12 documented and consistent.

jobs.title: Build review gemini adversarial
jobs.objective: Adversarial: migrate-repo-local idempotency under concurrent invocations; --confirm-delete + --keep-sqlite-readonly conflict; partial-migrate crash recovery; an unmigrated repo silently using an older client; method-registry holes where a mutation snuck in without a registered method; --no-daemon escape paths (env var, alias, sub-command bypass).
